items.description:
Chicko's Flame Grilled Chicken, now trading under the corrected name Chicko's Grill, is a flame-grilled chicken and fast-food outlet in Penina Park, Polokwane. The kitchen cooks chicken meals over an open flame and keeps a wider fast-food menu alongside them, aimed at customers who want a freshly prepared meal rather than something pre-packed and reheated.

It serves customers looking for prepared chicken and takeaway meals, from a quick weekday lunch to a family dinner picked up on the way home. The outlet trades from 40 Limpopo Avenue in Penina Park, Polokwane, and is a convenient stop for locals wanting flame-grilled chicken without booking a table at a sit-down restaurant.

Dalmada Kwekery is a plant nursery on the R71 just outside Polokwane, stocking plants and a range of other nursery products for anyone planning or maintaining a garden. Customers can browse the stock on site and choose plants suited to the growing conditions around Dalmada, rather than ordering sight unseen.

The nursery serves home gardeners, property owners and anyone else looking for plants and nursery products, from small pot plants to larger specimens for a new bed or border. Trading from the R71 in Dalmada, Polokwane, it is a convenient stop for gardeners in the surrounding farming community who prefer to choose their plants in person rather than order online.

Debonairs Pizza Cycad Centre is a branch of the national Debonairs Pizza chain, trading from Shop 6 at Cycad Centre in Bendor Park. The menu covers the chain's pizza ranges, including the Triple-Decker, and orders can be placed for collection, delivery or catering, with online ordering available for customers who prefer to order ahead of time.

The branch serves individuals, families and anyone else wanting pizza for a quick takeaway or a delivery to home or the office. It trades from Shop 6, Cycad Centre, on the corner of Outspan Drive and General Maritz Street in Bendor Park, Polokwane, making it an easy stop for pizza night in the area.

Dr ML Tjelele's dental practice in Hospital Park currently trades as Easy Smiles Dental Practice - Dr Tjelele, offering general and cosmetic dental care to patients in Polokwane. The practice is also classified as a paediatric dentistry, so younger patients can be treated at the same rooms as the rest of the family.

Treatment covers routine checkups and general dental work alongside cosmetic procedures for patients wanting to improve the appearance of their smile. The practice serves dental patients of all ages, including children, from its rooms at 70 Burger Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, giving local families a single base for ongoing dental care.

The shop's own description points to arrangements built around the event rather than a single standard bouquet, with in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery all offered to customers who would rather not travel into town for fresh flowers.

It serves customers buying flowers and arrangements for personal occasions and events, from everyday gestures to bigger celebrations, with delivery available for those who can't collect their order in person. Floral Avenue trades from 39 Bendor Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, and is a local option for shoppers wanting a florist close to home rather than ordering from a national chain.

The store stocks everyday groceries and household products for shoppers doing their regular shop close to home, rather than travelling into a larger centre across town, and keeps the kind of everyday lines a neighbourhood household runs through each week.

It serves local shoppers purchasing groceries and everyday household products, whether that's a quick top-up on the way home or a full weekly shop. Foodzone Supermarket trades from 34 Campbell Street in Ivy Park, Polokwane, making it a convenient, neighbourhood-level option for residents in the surrounding streets who want groceries without a long drive.

Gateway Electrical CC is an electrical-appliance wholesaler in Superbia, Polokwane, supplying electrical equipment and related supplies rather than operating as an on-site electrical contractor. Current business classification places the company on the wholesale side of the electrical trade, covering appliances and supporting stock for other buyers in the trade.

It serves customers and businesses requiring electrical equipment and related supplies, including trade buyers restocking for their own projects and customers sourcing appliances directly. Gateway Electrical CC trades from 43 Nikkel Street in Superbia, part of Polokwane Extension 13, and acts as a wholesale source for electrical goods in the area.

J-Med Pharmacy is a community pharmacy in Bendor, Polokwane, offering pharmacy and wider healthcare services to patients in the area. Current business classification lists it as a pharmacy, community health centre, child healthcare centre, drug store and health-and-beauty shop, covering dispensing alongside general health and beauty products under one roof.

The pharmacy serves local patients and customers requiring pharmacy and healthcare products and services, including families needing child healthcare support as well as everyday prescription and over-the-counter needs. J-Med Pharmacy trades from 379 De Wet Drive in Bendor, Polokwane, giving Bendor residents a nearby pharmacy for both medicine and general health and beauty purchases.

Jumbo Foods is a food distribution business in Ladanna, Polokwane, operating as a wholesale supplier to the local trade. Rather than selling to the public over a counter, the business moves stock through its own wholesale distribution channel to other buyers who then sell it on to shoppers, so its day-to-day trade runs on bulk orders rather than single-item sales.

It serves retail and commercial customers requiring food and wholesale distribution, from smaller shops restocking shelves to other businesses buying food products in bulk for their own operations. Jumbo Foods trades from 29 Silicon Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, and continues to operate as a wholesale food distribution point for buyers in the surrounding area.

items.description:
On Grobler Street in Polokwane Central stands this branch of the KFC fast-food chain, specialising in fried chicken, chicken meals and wings for customers wanting a quick meal in the city centre. Orders can be eaten in, collected as takeaway or taken for delivery, giving shoppers and office workers nearby a fast option without leaving the CBD.

The restaurant serves customers seeking quick-service chicken and takeaway meals, from a solo lunch order to a family-sized bucket picked up on the way home. KFC Polokwane trades from 24 Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, placing it within easy reach of the other shops and offices along the street.

KFC Mankweng Paledi Mall is a branch of the national KFC fast-food chain, trading at the corner of the R71 and University Road in Mankweng. The branch specialises in chicken meals and takeaway food, giving residents and students in the area a fast-food option without travelling into central Polokwane.

Customers in Mankweng and the surrounding areas make up the branch's main trade, including shoppers passing through the Paledi Mall precinct and students from the nearby university campus. Positioned on this busy corner, the restaurant is a convenient stop for a quick chicken meal on the way to or from the mall.

Fried chicken, chicken wings and other takeaway meals are served at this KFC branch on Market Street in Polokwane Central, part of the national KFC fast-food chain. The restaurant is set up for a fast turnaround, whether customers are eating in, collecting an order or grabbing a meal between errands in the CBD, and the menu follows the same fried-chicken range found at other KFC branches around Polokwane.

It serves customers seeking quick-service chicken meals in central Polokwane, from workers on a lunch break to families stopping in after a day of shopping. The branch is found at 83 Market Street, Polokwane Central, within walking distance of other stores and offices nearby.

Inside Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, Shop 5 is home to a branch of the KFC fast-food chain, serving fried chicken and other fast-food meals to shoppers visiting the centre. The branch fits into the mall's food offering, giving visitors a fried-chicken option alongside the centre's other restaurants and takeaways.

Savannah Mall shoppers and customers looking for takeaway or quick-service food make up the branch's customer base, whether they're grabbing a meal between errands or stopping in after browsing the mall's stores. KFC Savannah Mall trades from Shop 5 on Grimm Road at the corner of Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane.

items.description:
Metropolitan Polokwane (Market Street) is a branch of the Metropolitan Life group, offering long-term insurance, financial planning and investment products to customers in Polokwane Central. The branch is listed as a financial institution covering insurance, financial planning and investment services, reflecting the range of advice and policies on offer, from life cover to savings and investment planning.

Metropolitan is one of South Africa's established insurance and financial-services brands, and the Market Street branch gives local customers a point of access to its advisers without needing to deal with a call centre or an online-only channel. The office is based at Metropolitan Centre, 51 Market Street in Polokwane Central, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm, making it a convenient stop for anyone wanting to discuss insurance or financial planning in person.

Mochachos Polokwane CBD trades from Shop 9 in The Terrace Shopping Centre on Schoeman Street, in the heart of Polokwane's CBD, and takes orders for delivery through both Uber Eats and Mr D as well as in-store and takeaway service. The menu centres on flame-grilled, Mexican-spiced chicken, chicken burgers and a range of Mexican-style dishes such as burritos, fajitas and chimichangas.

The Mochachos brand opened its first restaurant in Pretoria in 1994 under the name Mochachos Steak Villages, one of the earliest South African outlets to combine flame-grilled chicken with a Mexican-inspired menu, and the brand has since expanded into Botswana, Zambia, Mauritius and Australia. For CBD shoppers and office workers, the Polokwane branch offers a familiar, fast meal either picked up in person or delivered to the door.

items.description:
Paledi Build It is a hardware and building-materials store trading from Shop 96 at Twin City Shopping Centre in Paledi, Mankweng. The branch offers deliveries, credit facilities, paint mixing and help reading building plans, services that support customers planning or carrying out building projects of any size.

It trades under the Build It banner, a retail group of more than 390 stores across Southern Africa that has supplied building materials to local communities for more than 35 years, built around values the group describes as family, entrepreneurship and passion. The Mankweng branch serves home builders, contractors and renovators in and around Paledi, giving the area a local source for building supplies backed by a national retail network.

PEP is South Africa's largest single-brand retailer, founded in 1965, and its Savannah Mall branch trades from Shops 51-53B in Fauna Park, Polokwane. The store is described on its own Polokwane Savannah Mall page as a family favourite, offering affordable, good-quality clothing for men, women and children alongside homeware and tech accessories.

The branch sits among the mall's fashion and footwear stores, giving Savannah Mall shoppers a budget-friendly option alongside larger chain outlets. PEP's long-standing position in South African retail is built on keeping prices low without sacrificing quality, and the Savannah Mall store serves value-conscious shoppers and families doing everyday clothing and homeware shopping while visiting the centre.

Polokwane Battery Centre supplies and fits automotive batteries from its premises on Orient Drive in Nirvana, stocking brands including Exide and Raylite for a wide range of passenger and commercial vehicles. The centre offers battery checks alongside fitment, and fitment is provided free of charge when a battery is bought from the store.

Batteries sold through the centre carry a nationwide guarantee, giving customers cover beyond the Polokwane area, and the business also supplies batteries on a wholesale basis to other dealers and businesses alongside its retail counter trade. This mix of retail and wholesale supply suits both individual vehicle owners needing a single replacement battery and commercial customers sourcing batteries in volume, from its Nirvana premises on Orient Drive.

PostNet Ivy Park is a branch of the national PostNet network, providing courier, postal and related business services such as printing and copying support for customers in and around Ivy Park. The branch is confirmed through PostNet's own store page as trading from Shop 5 in Ivy Park Centre, on the corner of Marshall and Campbell Street.

Customers use the branch to send and collect parcels, documents and courier items, relying on PostNet's network for both local and longer-distance deliveries. The Ivy Park store is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays and public holidays, making it a convenient stop for individuals and businesses in the suburb needing parcel or postal services during the week or on a Saturday morning.

PostNet Library Gardens trades from Shop 003A at the Library Gardens centre, on the corner of Grobler and Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central, as part of the national PostNet retail network. From this location the branch handles the day-to-day courier, postal and parcel work that keeps individuals and businesses connected, from sending a single parcel to managing regular business deliveries.

As with other PostNet stores, the branch also supports customers with printing, copying and related in-store services alongside its core courier and postal counter. Its central position on Grobler and Schoeman Street puts it within easy reach of businesses and residents in and around Polokwane's CBD, and the store is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

Shoprite LiquorShop Schoeman Street is a liquor retailer operating under the Shoprite LiquorShop brand, trading from Landdros Mare Street in central Polokwane. It stocks alcoholic beverages for customers of legal drinking age, operating alongside the wider Shoprite retail presence in the area, giving shoppers a familiar, convenient place to pick up wine, beer and spirits in the same trip.

Customer feedback for the store has highlighted friendly, helpful staff and a welcoming shopping atmosphere, the kind of everyday service that keeps local shoppers coming back for their usual purchases. Based in Polokwane Central, the store gives residents and visitors in the area a convenient, well-known liquor outlet to call on, whether for a quick top-up or a bigger stock-up before a weekend gathering.

items.description:
Ensemble Security is a private security company in Dalmada, Polokwane, trading as Ensemble Trading 2366 cc. The company is registered with the Private Security Regulatory Authority (PSIRA) and was formed in 2001. Its services include armed guarding for homes, businesses and factories, along with asset recovery carried out by licensed private investigators.

The company says its staff are professionally trained and provide full services on a 24-hour basis, monitored from its own offices and control centres. Due diligence and background investigation are offered for businesses weighing up future investments and partnerships. The firm operates across manufacturing, financial institutions, commercial buildings, residential property, retail, colleges and universities, and distribution facilities.

Fjiet Fjieuw is a jewellery boutique at The Farmyard Trading Post in Bendor, Polokwane, known for handmade pieces with a vintage and bohemian feel. The range covers rings, earrings, bracelets, pendants and watch accessories, and many pieces are made in sterling silver. Popular lines include birthstone rings, leaf bracelets, personalised bangles with heart charms and initial neck pieces.

The boutique describes its rings as timeless pieces with a gentle nod to vintage charm, designed to be worn, layered and loved. Customers can pay through secure payment platforms online, and orders over R2,000 qualify for free delivery. The business says it has served more than 10,000 customers, and the shop is at Shop LG12 on the corner of Munnik Avenue and School Road in Bendor.

Handy Garments Polokwane is the Nikkel Street branch of a clothing supplier that says it has been in business for more than 50 years. It supplies promotional clothing, corporate wear, workwear, headwear, PPE and safety footwear, with work and safety wear for hospitality and industry customers. Golf T-shirts and other promotional items are also part of the range.

The company says it holds large volumes of stock, which allows rapid distribution to customers. Buyers choose items from the website's categories, add the quantity they need to the cart and send a quote request. The shop is at 27 Nikkel Street in Superbia, Polokwane, and the menswear, schoolwear and workwear lines listed on its site are stocked there.

Northern Academy High School is a Curro-group secondary school in Flora Park, Polokwane, teaching learners from Grade 8 to Grade 12 under the national CAPS curriculum. The school is a Meridian school, which places it in the Curro group as part of a joint venture with Old Mutual. It prepares Grade 12 learners for the NSC examinations and offers Sepedi as an additional language option.

Teaching follows a project-based approach, so learners explore the material through research, experiments and assignments as well as regular tests. Class sizes are deliberately limited to give learners personal attention. A fully fitted boarding facility takes learners who do not live nearby, and the school is at 243 Suid Street in Flora Park.

Orel Christian Care Flora Park is the pre-school branch of the Orel Christian School group, taking children from three months old through to Grade R. The centre describes itself as a Christian school registered with the Department of Education, and it has safe play areas for its youngest learners. Lessons are child-centred and designed to help children become independent and adapt to different environments.

The programme has a Bible-based foundation, and children develop music, sharing and creative skills as part of the day. The Flora Park branch was taking applications for 2027 admissions, and families can download application forms and stationery lists for each age group. Stationery is available from PNA Mall of the North, and the branch is on Marshall Street in Flora Park.

Peakanyo Primary School is a public primary school in Seshego, offering ordinary education to learners in Zone One. The school is classified as a no-fee institution, and government funding covers its essential running costs under South Africa's no-fee policy. Around 323 learners and 10 educators were recorded at the school in 2023.

The school is classified as Quintile 3 and is located at Stand 1910 in Zone One, Seshego, in Limpopo. Its uniform policy follows the South African Schools Act and guidance from the Limpopo Education Department, and families who want the detailed uniform rules are directed to the school administration.

Spec-Savers The Greenery is an optometry practice and eyewear store in Shop 13 at The Greenery, on the corner of Oost Street and Thabo Mbeki Street in Polokwane, part of the national Spec-Savers chain. Customers can book an eye test through the store, and the range includes spectacles, sunglasses and contact lenses. Lens enhancements, eye exams and guides to lens types and face shapes are available to help customers choose.

The store says it combines professional standards with quality eyewear at affordable prices, and that its staff are well trained to provide optometric services and help customers find the right frame. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 3pm, which suits shoppers visiting the centre during the week or at weekends.
